mentions.name: MCP-B
mentions.description: Browser extension for building and injecting web MCP servers into websites via userscripts. Along the way it gained a modern userscript manager with a built-in marketplace, where users can vibe code any userscript and publish it to the marketplace directly from the extension; automation remains the core value proposition.
mentions.source_excerpt: I left my job to work on my side project (MCP-B: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44515403) full time. I set out with the goal of making the ability to vibecode a webMCP server for your website and inject it via userscript.
